title: Rust: String Manipulation
description: Advanced string manipulation: split, join, replace, and regex matching.

steps.title: Split a String
steps.description: Write a function that splits the string `"apple,banana,cherry,date"` by commas and prints each fruit on its own line.
hints: `s.split(",")` returns an iterator over the substrings.
Use `.for_each()` or a for loop to print each.
The split iterator can be collected with `.collect::<Vec<&str>>()`.

verification.failureMessage: Split the CSV string and print each fruit.

steps.title: Join Strings
steps.description: Given `["Rust", "is", "fast"]`, join them with spaces using `.join(" ")` and print.

verification.failureMessage: Join the words with spaces and print.

steps.title: Replace Substrings
steps.description: Use `str::replace` to replace all occurrences of `"cat"` with `"dog"` in `"The cat sat on the mat"`. Print the result.
hints: Result: 'The dog sat on the mat'

steps.title: Trim and Uppercase
steps.description: Clean up `"  hello world  "` using `.trim()` and `.to_uppercase()`. Print the cleaned string.

verification.failureMessage: Trim whitespace and convert to uppercase.

steps.title: Extract Words with Regex
steps.description: Use the `regex` crate to extract all words (alphabetic sequences) from `"Rust1 is2 great3!"` using `\b[a-zA-Z]+\b`. Print each word.
hints: You can use `Regex::new(r"[a-zA-Z]+")` — no need for external crate in practice.

verification.failureMessage: Extract and print all pure alphabetic words.
